claim_one_line: THE FLOOR AT THE CUP KERNEL, SEALED. Lemma F (proved at design time): at the trivial character on a finite cover with m cusps, every class c of H^1(N; rho) has I(W) >= k - m - 1, k the number of cusps where c is non-zero; so sm:B1543's floor I(W) >= -1 holds wherever c is non-zero on every cusp, and three, I(W) = -3, needs c to vanish on two cusps. With Theorem C (ii) (Corollary F'), three needs a + rk delta1_W <= n(1) - 2 and k <= m - 2; on the four degree-60 covers (n(1) = 3) it can live only in the cup map's kernel K0, at the strata K0(S) of three closed supports of size four on d10.13's and d10.36's covers and nowhere on d10.16's and d10.40's (Proposition D, from the structure and banked counts). The run reads the generic class of K0(S) for every closed support S on N_45 and the four covers -- which decides the least I(W) on all of K0 (Lemma G'') -- in route F and route R: 30 subspaces, 90 tasks, 180 readings. Controls K1-K6 hold. Predictions P1-P6 (P4 the floor on K0 70%, P6 three 4%); PROVED if a stratum reads I(W) < -1 in two routes; NEGATIVE if the floor holds on all of K0, and then the four degree-60 covers carry no three at the trivial character. No count at a non-interior class of K0 read. 0 of 19.
